- Karthik: confirm rollout window and whether we need an additional canary capacity for week 1.
- Ben: final SLA/credits language — procurement asked for explicit incident credit thresholds.
- Naomi: docs + security checklist — any outstanding evidence needed for ACME procurement?

Meeting: 30m tomorrow 09:00 PT — calendar invite sent. If you can't make it, reply here with your owner updates so I can include them in the QBR pack.

Thanks,
